g.text: LEAF HEAT / Wi-Fi + one CAN channel

g.desc: LEAF HEAT / Wi-Fi + one CAN channel

g.text: REV D — HAND-SOLDER PROTOTYPE — FACTORY: U1 / U2 / U4 / L1

g.desc: REV D — HAND-SOLDER PROTOTYPE — FACTORY: U1 / U2 / U4 / L1

g.text: 3 UART PROGRAMMING — NO USB / NO PROGRAMMER POWER

g.desc: 3 UART PROGRAMMING — NO USB / NO PROGRAMMER POWER

g.text: 65 V buck with input fuse, reverse blocking and 24 V TVS.

g.desc: 65 V buck with input fuse, reverse blocking and 24 V TVS.

g.text: Transient energy, cold operation and parked draw require physical tests.

g.desc: Transient energy, cold operation and parked draw require physical tests.

g.text: J3: 1 GND | 2 board RX | 3 board TX. 3.3 V logic only.

g.desc: J3: 1 GND | 2 board RX | 3 board TX. 3.3 V logic only.

g.text: Power from a current-limited 12 V bench supply via J1 (9 +, 3 GND).

g.desc: Power from a current-limited 12 V bench supply via J1 (9 +, 3 GND).

g.text: Vehicle unplugged. Adapter power wire unused. Connect only with board powered.

g.desc: Vehicle unplugged. Adapter power wire unused. Connect only with board powered.

g.text: Hold BOOT; press/release RESET; release BOOT. Flash via UART0 at 115200 baud.

g.desc: Hold BOOT; press/release RESET; release BOOT. Flash via UART0 at 115200 baud.

g.text: Voltage sense is after the input diode: calibration required.

g.desc: Voltage sense is after the input diode: calibration required.

g.text: Software low-battery sleep is required; there is no hardware battery disconnect.

g.desc: Software low-battery sleep is required; there is no hardware battery disconnect.

g.text: CAN TX: GPIO4 | RX: GPIO5 | STB: GPIO1

g.desc: CAN TX: GPIO4 | RX: GPIO5 | STB: GPIO1

g.text: STB is pulled high during reset. Drive low only for a requested action.

g.desc: STB is pulled high during reset. Drive low only for a requested action.

g.text: 500 kbit/s, standard 11-bit frames; 2013–2015 Leaf profile to be confirmed.

g.desc: 500 kbit/s, standard 11-bit frames; 2013–2015 Leaf profile to be confirmed.

g.text: GPIO3 / GPIO18 / GPIO19 unused. No USB-presence sensing in Rev D.

g.desc: GPIO3 / GPIO18 / GPIO19 unused. No USB-presence sensing in Rev D.

g.text: OTA updates need firmware implementation. UART remains the recovery interface.

g.desc: OTA updates need firmware implementation. UART remains the recovery interface.

g.text: J1 pin 9: +12 V | pin 3: ground | pin 7: CAN-H | pin 2: CAN-L

g.desc: J1 pin 9: +12 V | pin 3: ground | pin 7: CAN-H | pin 2: CAN-L

g.text: Only use the Nissan ZE0/e-NV200 OVMS cable. Generic OBD cables differ.

g.desc: Only use the Nissan ZE0/e-NV200 OVMS cable. Generic OBD cables differ.
